tmp:2595: shattering one's own gadlut and self-honor completely — the act of breaking personal arrogance/pride so that God's honor becomes whole, achieved via shmirat habrit in both unifications (LM I:11)
tmp:2596: niggun played by hand — instrumental melody as the aspect of joy (simchah), the hand-music that gathers the good spirit from the evil spirit (LM I:54)
tmp:2597: guarding the memory (shmirat ha-zikaron) — the practice of constantly remembering the World to Come, protecting the faculty of holy remembrance from forgetfulness (LM I:54)
tmp:2598: guarding oneself from ka'as — restraint from anger as the essential protection of one's soul/name and of the wealth-flow being bestowed from Above (LM I:68)
tmp:2599: shmirat ha-shem / shmirat ha-nefesh — the paired guarding of one's name and soul, effected solely by refraining from anger, per Job 18:4 'he tears his soul in his anger' (LM I:68)
tmp:2600: the lachluchit (bodily moisture/humors) that ascends to the brain — physiological fluid functioning as the 'oil' feeding the wick (brain) and flame (soul), sustaining the intellect via the lungs
tmp:2601: beginning to compose a commentary — the moment a Torah expositor starts to offer an interpretation, requiring prior outpoured prayer to arouse the heart's warm words from the rock/heart (sela)
tmp:2602: speaking much with him (the Rebbe) — the action of frequent bold conversation with one's master, enabled by holy azut, which is what makes a disciple 'closer'
tmp:2603: becoming more aroused — the heightened spiritual awakening a disciple gains through holy boldness and increased speech with the tzaddik
tmp:2604: bringing the sparks out into speech and building holy speech from them — the tikkun-act of constructing dibbur d'kedushah, 'vayiven et ha-tzela' rectifying the limping thigh (tzole'a)
tmp:2605: being redeemed through teshuvah from the malkhut of the kelipot — liberation of the holy Kingship (dalet, 'nothing of its own') from the four kingdoms of the Sitra Achra via repentance, the essence of Yom Tov
tmp:2607: koach u-fo'al — the pair potential-and-actualization, mapped onto the two hands right and left as instruments through which spirit comes into existence
tmp:2608: the two hands, right and left — bodily limbs as kelei ha-asiyah where the ruach is revealed ('into Your hand I entrust my spirit'), symbolizing potential and act
tmp:2610: the twelve nuschaot (liturgical rites) of prayer — the twelve prayer-versions corresponding to Yaakov and his twelve sons, brought down into Egyptian exile
tmp:2611: the twelve gates of prayer — the twelve heavenly sha'arei tefillah through which each tribe's prayer ascends, embodied in Yaakov and his sons
tmp:2612: speech becoming rectified and built — the state of dibbur repaired/constructed through abundant mitzvot and joy nullifying the anxiety of sin, enabling confession
tmp:2613: expelling the ruach shtut (spirit of folly) from within oneself — the urgent act of driving out the folly-spirit clinging to the heart, accomplished by soul-love binding to the true tzaddik
tmp:2614: 'Mi' (fifty gates of Binah) through which the mouth (peh) comes into being — Exodus 4:11 'Mi sam peh la-adam,' the mouth formed via the fifty of Understanding at the Exodus
tmp:2615: judging everyone favorably (dan le-khaf zekhut) — the practice of finding merit for all, which enables silence under insult and forms the chirik point
tmp:2616: remaining silent when someone shames him — the response of shtikah to public disgrace (enabled by judging favorably), forming the chirik/footstool point beneath the Alef
tmp:2617: atzat nachash / atzat resha'im — the serpent's counsel, counsel of the wicked (the 'scorpions' encircling Sinai) that blocks receiving the tzaddikim's counsel of true seed
tmp:2618: the principle that the main strengthening of the Gevurot comes only through Chasadim — inclusion of the left in the right, kindness empowering the severities (while fear still precedes)
tmp:2619: the making/rectification of leshon ha-kodesh depending on yirah — 'vayiven, He made her like a storehouse': the Holy Tongue's tikkun hangs on 'the fear of God is His treasury' (Isa. 33:6)
tmp:2620: the hairs (se'arot) of the wise man — the chakham's surplus mentalities (motrei mochin) figured as hairs, which become gates for transmitting his wisdom
tmp:2621: sha'ar with the shin vowelled to the right (kamatz/yamin) — 'gate': the wise man's hair-surplus read as ShA'aR, gates opening wisdom for divine service (vs. se'ar of the fool)
tmp:2622: the Gate of Aram (sha'ar Aram/Rome) — the specific gate in R. Yosei ben Kisma's prophecy that must fall three times before Ben David comes
tmp:2623: the gate of the Sitra Achra — the Other Side's gate (identified with the Gate of Aram), whose repeated collapse precedes Messiah building the gates of holiness
tmp:2624: speech in its completeness (dibbur bi-shleimut) — perfected speech, the 'clear lip' (safah berurah, Zeph. 3:9) when all nations call on God, completing the letters of speech
tmp:2625: penei ha-menorah — the 'face of the lamp' (Num. 8:2) symbolizing the divine influx (shefa Eloki) toward which the seven lamps/orifices shine
tmp:2626: sanctifying one's mouth, nose, eyes, and ears — the prerequisite purification of the four facial organs (truth, fear of Heaven, guarded eyes, faith in sages) to receive the divine influx
tmp:2627: the aforementioned shefa Eloki — the divine influx identified with ruach ha-kodesh and the sukkah, a makif-intellect too great to enter the brain, encircling the head
tmp:2628: doubled abundance (shefa kefulah) — the 'lechem mishneh' double portion (Ex. 16) / 'mirkevet ha-mishneh' of Yosef, granted for subduing Amalek's kelipah and rectifying the brit
tmp:2629: 'mayim mayim' (water, water — Chagigah 14b warning) — symbol of falsehood: tears/salty water that increases rather than quenches thirst
tmp:2630: being drawn after the medammeh — the state of following the imaginative faculty of the heart instead of ascending to intellect, equated with stubbornness of heart
tmp:2631: shrirut lev — 'stubbornness of heart' (Deut. 29:18): the stone-heart condition of following the heart's imagination, broken by the shamir
tmp:2632: the six days (of creation/week) — corresponding to the six handbreadths of the amah/brit, all 'rested' into the seventh day, Shabbat, which is the covenant (Ex. 31:16)
tmp:2633: the six tefachim (handbreadths) of the cubit — measure of the amah/brit in the circumcision-kavvanah, paralleling the seraph's six wings and the six weekdays
tmp:2634: the Six Orders of the Mishnah (Shas) — corresponding to Metatron whose dominion is the six weekdays, aspect of the lower unification (yichuda tata'ah)
tmp:2635: tikkun of the kaneh (windpipe/voice-organ) — rectifying the vocal conduit ('kenei lekha chaver' read as kaneh), linked to hearing the niggun and building one's malkhut
tmp:2636: the principle that the essence of avodat Hashem is attaining good middot and good deeds — service in measured gradation, possible only via tzimtzum of the heart's infinite flame
